name: Strands Agent Chatbot with AgentCore
description: AWS reference chatbot combining Strands Agents and Bedrock AgentCore with skills, memory, browser automation and agent-to-agent calls.
whatItDoes: An end-to-end assistant that can run code, browse, produce Office documents and reach services such as Gmail, Calendar, Notion and GitHub through skills. It is a realistic sample for teams designing agent architectures on AWS.
howItWorks: A web chat frontend talks to Strands agents hosted on AgentCore Runtime, using AgentCore memory, code interpreter and browser tools plus more than twenty skills. Infrastructure is deployed with Terraform before the app is started.

requirements.name: AWS account
requirements.description: Bedrock, AgentCore and supporting infrastructure deployed with Terraform
